Hi Priya — great to meet yesterday. Thanks for the thoughtful questions on inference latency and data residency. Per our conversation, I put together a short mutual evaluation plan (attached) that spells out milestones, owners, and a proposed close timeline so we can get a reliable cost/latency signal for your internal stakeholders.

High level (see attached MAP):
- Week 0: Onboarding & infra checklist (RD credentials, sample data path, security questionnaire) — owner: AstraHealth (Priya) + Redwood (Monica)
- Week 1–2: Proof-run with sample queries, model variant comparison — owner: Redwood SE (Karthik) + Astra ML lead
- Week 3: Latency/cost baseline & optimization recommendations (batching/quant) — owner: Redwood ML (Rishi)
- Week 4: Executive review & close recommendation — owner: Jordan + Astra product

Ask: Can you confirm the internal technical lead who will own the dataset and test harness on your side (we had 'ML lead' in the meeting but I want a direct owner)? Also please review the SOC2/evidence checklist and tell us which control artifacts you can share this week.

I copied Karthik (Solutions Engineer) and Monica (Customer Success) — Karthik will run the technical walkthrough and Rishi will be your ML contact for tuning/quantization recommendations. I attached the draft MAP and the SOC2 evidence template we typically use.

Proposed near-term cadence: 30m technical sync next Tue (Oct 5) to align test harness and data samples; 60m readout 2 weeks after. What times work for you?

Thanks — looking forward.

—

Jordan / Priya — thanks. 10/5 10:00am ET works for me; I've put together the bullets below that I'll present in the 30m sync. Attaching a short 'deployment-options' one-pager (stubbed here as an attachment).

Quick bullets for Tue sync:
- Regions & residency: Hosted API (default) runs in multi-region US/EU/ASIA; for strict EU residency we recommend Dedicated in eu-west-1 or Redwood Private deployed inside Astra's EU VPC. Dedicated can be provisioned in ~7–10 business days depending on capacity; Private timeline depends on infra readiness and can be 3–6 weeks.
- Tradeoffs: Dedicated provides strong isolation and SLA with predictable throughput; Private gives full control of network/hardware and is required for certain compliance regimes.
- Test harness checklist (what we'll need in the sync): sample CSV (<=1000 rows for initial run), schema example, expected max sequence length, example prompt templates, whether responses should include redaction markers.
- Quick model guidance for Rishi to consider: start with 7B FP16 baseline vs 7B int8 quant for perf delta; measure p95 latency at 256/512 tokens.

I'll attach the one-pager and a calendar invite once Jordan confirms time.

—Karthik
